{{Top|leg}}
'''"Tionjack"''' was a term used to describe the [[Warship/Legends|warships]] of the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion|Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion]] during the [[Tionese War]]. They were described as [[Copper/Legends|copper]]-colored with [[Color/Legends|red]] sigils on their [[Conning tower/Legends|conning towers]], and were armed with [[Flamethrower/Legends|incendiary weapons]], [[Dioxis/Legends|dioxis]] flares, [[pressure bomb]]s, and [[Plasma cannon/Legends|plasma cannons]] that could be used in [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardments]].

Three Tionjacks were involved in a raid on [[Okator VIII]] towards the end of the Tionese War, destroying virtually all the settlements and leaving only [[Unidentified Republic soldier (Falang Minor)|one known survivor]].
